scenario: AITA for telling my girlfriend that I don't care about what she is talking about? | Throwaway account. Last night my girlfriend and I were hanging out on the couch. Maybe it wasn't the nicest way to put it but she was talking about something irrelevant that I honestly did not care about while I was in the middle of reading something. If she would have waited until I was finished reading I probably wouldn't have said that and just listened to her dumb stories. Well she got super pissed by my comment and said "I listen to you talk about stuff that I don't care about" then she left my house. I didn't hear from her for the rest of the night and today she is talking to me but only one or two word responses. So AITA?
